config.name: FlightChain MCP Server
config.description: Emergency response system linking Arduino → Pinata → XRPL → ElevenLabs AI

get_flight_status.description: Returns NOMINAL or CRASH status with active CID
get_flight_status.when_called: AI checks status at any point during emergency

get_crash_evidence.description: Fetches crash JSON from IPFS. AI reads CID aloud as proof

declare_emergency.description: Pins crash telemetry → gets CID → prepares NFTokenModify → flags escrow
declare_emergency.when_called: Arduino detects G > 3.5 or judge orders test

list_recent_events.description: Full audit trail of all pinned events

elevenLabs.setup: Point ElevenLabs agent config to this file
elevenLabs.voice_flow: Arduino shake → declare_emergency → AI initiates mayday → Judge tests → AI reads proof

pinata_xrpl_link.explanation: Pinata holds the crash data (large JSON), XRPL holds the pointer (CID in NFT URI)
pinata_xrpl_link.implementation: declare_emergency pins JSON, returns CID, which gets inserted into NFTokenModify transaction
pinata_xrpl_link.cost_efficiency: Avoids expensive on-chain storage; uses IPFS for data, blockchain for state
